hv3_023.question: How many EPSS events occurred on PG&E circuits in Tier 3 HFTD areas in 2023?
hv3_023.note: The spatial summary can count events inside one HFTD tier. The old rule fired because the question says circuits. It now fires only when the request is for the circuit inventory plus a tier, or for HFTD area. The router still does not build that spatial call itself.
